title: Items, Rewards, Treasure, Handouts & Player Artifact Authoring
objective: Extend the prepared MAS Adventure workspace with deterministic Items, Rewards, Treasure, Handouts and Player Artifact Authoring over the MAS-01..12 foundations while preserving canonical Inventory/Item/Asset, ARI/D29 resource/provenance, reward/runtime and player-artifact owner authority and keeping prepared authored artifacts distinct from awarded, transferred, published or live player state.

scope.purpose: Represent prepared Item, Reward, Treasure, Handout and Player Artifact authoring inside the MAS workspace without turning authored definitions into canonical inventory ownership, awarded rewards, transferred treasure, published handouts or live player-state mutation.
scope.completion_gate: A representative MAS workspace can deterministically author prepared item/reward/treasure/handout/player-artifact structures over completed MAS foundations with explicit owner/resource references and fail-closed invalid states while preserving canonical owner/runtime authority and never treating prepared artifacts as awarded, transferred, published or live player truth.

selection_boundaries: ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json was reconsulted after MAS-12, including current MSLR planning, and unlocks no new cross-program rotation at this milestone; MAS strict-order continuation therefore selects MAS-13.
This checkpoint selects MAS-13 only; it does not grant implementation authority.
No MAS-13 implementation branch exists until a later owner Continue governed-starts MAS-13.
MAS-01 through MAS-12 remain completed foundations and are not reopened silently.

The MAS prepared-artifact-vs-live doctrine remains controlling: authored Items, Rewards, Treasure, Handouts or Player Artifacts do not by themselves mutate canonical Inventory/Item/Asset state, grant rewards, transfer ownership, publish player-visible artifacts or create Action/Event truth.

Detailed MAS-13 Inventory/Item/Asset, reward, ARI/D29 resource/provenance, handout/player-artifact and runtime owner seams are intentionally deferred to governed start and targeted dependency loading rather than invented at selection time.
MAS-14 retains Dialogue, Social Scene, Rumor & Conditional Content Integration scope and must not be pulled forward.
CNI-12 and PCA remain unselected; MAS-14+ and SMB-08 remain unauthorized.
next_action: Wait for the next owner Continue to governed-start MAS-13; do not implement while selected_not_started.
